title: ZOE native gate result
description: One run of the native gate, the phase 3 gate of N4 (ADR 0039): zoe serve through the native client (zoe-native) against ZEO 6 through ZEO.ClientStorage (zeo), in alternating batches, on one machine, with one Python build. Results are numbers about a synthetic corpus, never data.

workers.description: One item per worker process of one storage in the cell: one process in the threads mode, one per worker in the processes mode.

gil_enabled.description: sys._is_gil_enabled() when the process ended; true on a build with the GIL.

gil_enabled_by.description: The modules that turned the GIL back on in the process, from the warnings of CPython. Empty on a build with the GIL.

seconds.description: The time of the slowest worker for one transaction.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema. A change that a reader of the previous version cannot read increments it.

machine.description: The machine that ran the gate, as in the results of the harness. It holds no host name, user name or path.

python.description: The Python build that ran both clients.

free_threaded.description: True for a build without the GIL, such as 3.14t.

software.description: The version of each distribution and server in the run, keyed by name.

started.description: When the run started, in UTC.

commit.description: The ZOE commit of the harness, or null when it is not known.

seconds.description: The wall time of the run.

dirty.description: True when the tree of the harness held changes that the commit does not; false when it held none; null when git fails. Optional: results without it stay valid, but only false is publishable (ADR 0054).

rule.description: The rule that stopped the pairs of each scenario. The report applies it again to the pairs.

min_pairs.description: The pairs before a verdict can stop a scenario.

max_pairs.description: The most pairs of a scenario.

max_seconds.description: The time after which a scenario takes no new pair.

level.description: The confidence level of the interval of the mean of the log of the ratios.

batch_seconds.description: The time that a batch lasts about: the warmup pair of a scenario sets its transactions per batch from it.

max_transactions.description: The most transactions of a batch.

cells.description: One entry per cell that the run measured.

mode.description: threads: the workers are threads of one process on one DB. processes: each worker is a process with its own DB.

object_size.description: The size of each object, in bytes.

transactions.description: The transactions that each worker runs in a row in one batch. A time of a pair is the time of the slowest worker for one of them.

pairs.description: The pairs in the order that they ran. The warmup pair is not in the list.

first.description: The storage whose batch ran first in the pair.

ratio.description: The geometric mean of the ratios t_zeo / t_zoe of the pairs, as the rule gives it; null when it is not finite. Optional: results without it stay valid.

low.description: The low bound of the interval of the rule at its level; null when it is not finite. Optional.

high.description: The high bound of the interval of the rule at its level; null when it is not finite, as with fewer than 2 pairs. Optional.

verdict.description: pass when the low bound is above 1, fail when the high bound is below 1, after at least min_pairs pairs; null when the scenario is undecided. Optional.
